scope.analysis_scope: Custom — Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers on Sunday, October 18, 2026, and Washington Commanders at San Francisco 49ers on Monday, October 19, 2026

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games per player before the cutoff

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 5
historical_cutoff.game: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Rams
historical_cutoff.status: reported in the existing repository Stage 0 artifact; not independently re-verified in this retry
historical_cutoff.verification: Confirmed against NFL.com 2026 Week 5 schedule: Bills at Rams completed Monday, October 12, 2026.

source_snapshot.sportsbook_priority: FanDuel primary; DraftKings fallback only when FanDuel is unavailable.
source_snapshot.fallback_used: DraftKings — no FanDuel rows were present for either selected event in the retrieved odds dataset.
source_snapshot.timestamp_note: The CSV does not expose a snapshot timestamp; its recency beyond being the latest repository file cannot be independently verified.
source_snapshot.main_line_method: The file has no main-line indicator. For each eligible player/market, the listed line whose over price is closest to -110 was selected as the central/main market line. Exact line and price are retained from the source.

stage1_summary.qualification_rule: Current Market HR ≥60% OR at least one applicable fixed ladder HR ≥80%; for L10, ≥6/10 OR ≥8/10.
stage1_summary.market_scope: QB Passing Yards; RB Rushing Yards; WR/TE Receiving Yards; WR/TE Receptions.
stage1_summary.P16_P7_rule: Calculated independently from the 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season game logs before the cutoff using standard linear interpolation (rank=(n-1)*q). The L10 percentile sample is identical to the locked L10 observations.

validation.known_prompt_inconsistency: The Stage 1 qualification gate and Requirements Registry R10 specify OR; a later checklist bullet appears to require both conditions for every qualifier. The explicit gate and R10 were applied.
